name: sun
description: A clear circular sun with eight short, evenly spaced rays in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The solid disc radius is 5.95, exactly 5.1 plus half the Regular 1.70 stroke. Each shortened ray is an exact width-1.70 capsule with radius-.85 round ends around its original radial centerline from radius 8.2 to 9.2. The disc is solid; there is no counter. This follows the owner request for a larger disc and shorter rays while retaining the original overall dimensions and Regular stroke weight. Native X/Y=100% and rotation=0 are the reference. Compare contours at equal rotation. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Sun Outline and Filled after enlarging the central disc and shortening the eight rays. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.
